//engines: Node 22+ is required, not just preferred. jsdom (pulled in by isomorphic-dompurify, which sanitises every CMS-authored HTML field) reaches an ESM-only dependency through require(). Node 22.12 made that legal; on Node 20 it throws ERR_REQUIRE_ESM at request time, which took down every server-rendered route in production while prerendered pages kept working. Hosts such as Vercel read this field to pick the runtime.

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd api && npm install && cd ../web && npm install
